title: Antigravity usage limits in the status bar
text: When Antigravity is installed and signed in, Seismic's status bar now shows how much of its plan's usage limits is used, next to the Claude and Codex meters. A click lists every limit Antigravity reports, per model group, with when each one resets. The numbers refresh every minute and reading them uses none of the quota.
chapters: A third meter in the bar
